3-01.title: The Duck Race
3-01.fullText: Stage 3 First Phonics The Duck Race This story is called The Duck Race. Written by Roderick Hunt and illustrated by Alex Brickda. When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Let's read the story together. Wilma had an idea. The children made six ducks. Let's have a duck race, said Wilma. Mom began the race. Drop the ducks in, said Mom. The ducks went down the stream. No! Wilma's duck sank. Dip's duck got stuck in the reeds. Biff's duck got stuck in the weeds. Wilf's duck got stuck on a log. Get it off with a stick, said Chip. Kipper's duck went fast. It went past Dad's duck. Two swans flew down. They landed on the ducks. Big soggy ducks, said Kipper.

3-02.title: Sniff
3-02.fullText: Stage 3. First Phonics. Sniff. This story is called Sniff. Written by Roderick Hunt and illustrated by Alex Brickta. When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Let's read the story together. Will you look after Sniff today? said Mrs. May. Wilf and Wilma were happy. They wanted to look after the puppy. They took Sniff to the park. The puppy was excited. Sniff liked to roll on her back, jump up for a stick, run after a ball, and bark at a cat. Then Sniff went in the mud. She ran after a duck. She jumped in the pond, and she barked at a dog. I am hot, said Wilf. I want to rest. I am hot too, said Wilma. I want a drink. Mom couldn't find Sniff. She couldn't find Wilf and Wilma. Mom and Dad looked and looked. They must be lost, said Mom. They were fast asleep. They're worn out, said Dad.

3-03.fullText: Stage 3. First Phonics. Pawn Dipping. This story is called Pawn Dipping. Let's read the story together. When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Pawn Dipping written by Roger Cunt and illustrated by Alex Brutta. Wilf and Wilma were at the pond. The net got stuck. Help me pull, said Wilf. They pulled the net. It was stuck on some junk. Wilma got a big stick. Let's pull it out, she said. Wilf and Wilma pulled. They couldn't pull the junk out. Mom and Dad helped. They pulled out an old pram. Plop? A frog hopped out. It made Wilf jump. It jumped up. A pram full of fish, said Dad. Dipping, said Wilma.
